languageHelp: Choose the language used throughout this workstation.
appearanceSessionOnly: Applied for this session. Browser storage is unavailable.

aboutDescription: Wave-based deep-learning experiments, planned and executed by your daemon.

trainingDefaultsDisconnected: Connect to a daemon to configure its training defaults.
loggingHelp: W&B remains optional. Its credentials and project selection belong to the daemon host or the explicit run draft. No previous run cache is deleted.
trainingDefaultsSaved: Defaults saved for new drafts on this daemon.
trainingDefaultsSaveFailed: Defaults could not be saved. Browser storage may be unavailable or full.
trainingDefaultsReset: Training defaults reset. Existing drafts and runs are unchanged.
companionLogsEmpty: No run logs are available yet.
downloadsSummary: Downloads stay under your browser's control.
